answer: Because the timing is written down against the vine challenge, the island audit can replay the anchor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 56 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 2924 identities would post 2668 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
